Lord Jagannath's Holy Bath Observed Ahead of Rath Yatra

Devotees participated in the Deva Snana Purnima ritual, observing the holy bathing of Lord Jagannath. This annual ceremony takes place before the Rath Yatra festival. The event is a significant religious observance for followers of Lord Jagannath.
